personal.name: Edwin Tovar

personal.tagline: 10+ years ensuring quality across Fintech, Banking, and Payment platforms
personal.bio: Computer Engineer and Senior QA Engineer with over 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance across Fintech, Banking, and Payment Media environments. Specialized in the full end-to-end testing cycle, from requirements analysis to execution, automation, and reporting. Hands-on experience in automated testing and in implementing Artificial Intelligence solutions applied to QA, optimizing script generation and maintenance, automated visual validation, and predictive defect analysis. Focused on continuous improvement, process efficiency, and delivering high-quality products in Agile environments (Scrum).

experience.description: Plan and execute manual and automated testing for Fintech platforms. Implement AI-driven testing solutions including Testim.io, Mabl, and Applitools Eyes. Integrate testing suites into CI/CD pipelines for automated executions during each build and deployment. Perform API testing with Postman, cloud testing in AWS Lambda, and accessibility testing with NVDA and VoiceOver.

Executed functional tests (Front-end, Back-end, API, Web Services). Designed and executed test cases for Corporate Home Banking. Used HP ALM, Postman, Insomnia, and Xray. Reported and tracked defects in Jira and Confluence.

Designed and executed functional and non-functional tests. Tested REST and XML services. Supported project coordination with Visa, MasterCard, and American Express. Generated test data and functional documentation.
Gathered, analyzed, and designed adaptive and corrective requirements. Coordinated with Product Managers and Stakeholders. Executed manual testing and managed incident tracking.
Designed and executed functional test cases (Smoke, Exploratory, Regression). Created test plans and estimates. Detected and documented defects in Jira.
